keyFindings.description: A3 regression from the start-turn hold: an owed startup card's wake fires right after the start turn is interrupted (Esc or RPC abort). #check's pending filter (500) keeps every startup card whatever #interrupted says, and unreadCards counts an owed card read only after a reply that follows a turn-ending reply, which an aborted start turn never has; the wake (nextTurn+triggerTurn) starts a turn with no latch check (agent-session.ts:9299-9308). Before this round the startup card's turn ran before the start turn, so no interrupt could come between. Reproduced by a scratch CardWake test (1 wake in tui and rpc mode) and by both thermonuclear passes; no test covers an interrupted start turn. The reason at 117-118 does not hold for an owed card.

The unsent-mark real-binary cases (around 1402) assert only that the first request contains the card, which a plain immediate steer (no pending mark) also satisfies; assert the request ends with the wake.
